title: Riot X Nic Salts Cherry Ice 10ml E-Liquid
description: Cherry Ice from Riot X delivers a bright and juicy cherry flavour with a crisp, cooling exhale. The deep, sweet notes of ripe cherries burst with fruity intensity, while an icy layer adds a refreshing lift to every inhale. Balancing rich sweetness with a clean, frosty finish, this flavour offers a smooth and satisfying vape from start to finish. Part of Riot Squad’s Riot X collection, this e-liquid is crafted to replicate the intense, double-concentrated flavours found in the most popular single-use disposables. Supplied in a 10ml bottle, it’s an excellent choice for vapers switching from disposables to refillable MTL (mouth-to-lung) pod kits, offering the same vibrant taste with the added benefits of convenience and cost efficiency. Riot X Salt E-Liquids are made with Riot Squad’s Hybrid Nicotine blend, a combination of freebase nicotine and nicotine salts. This innovative mix, along with the 50PG/50VG ratio, ensures a well-balanced vape with bold flavour, a smooth throat hit, and satisfying vapour production. Please note: this flavour profile may contain hints of 'ice'.
